title: Decide with Jev: Three Questions in One Request with the Laravel AI SDK
content:
A single yes or no doesn't tell you much about a draft. In this episode of Decide with Jev, we ask Jev three questions in one request and get back a Boolean, a choice and a score. Then we read every part of each answer in PHP.

The post Decide with Jev: Three Questions in One Request with the Laravel AI SDK appeared first on Laravel News.
